name: Maxwel Jones
tagline: One-page site for a holding that unites an entrepreneur network: an animated Learn / Earn / Return story, a network panel and a two-step contact journey
role: For Maxwel Jones, a holding built around learn, earn, return, I designed a page that tells a vision through scroll. Eight GSAP-animated sections, a side panel of network members, a contact form and a meeting-booking prototype to validate the journey before investing in a real system. After a V1 I refactored into feature modules and documented the choices. 71 commits, live on maxweljones.com.

meta.title: Maxwel Jones · Case study
meta.description: Narrative one-pager for a holding: GSAP storytelling, network panel and two-step contact.

paragraphs: Maxwel Jones is not a one-click product. It is a holding with a Learn / Earn / Return philosophy and a network of people. The site had to make that model clear and desirable, with a premium black-and-gold feel.
First screen had to set identity: letter-by-letter hero, gold bars, header that appears at the right moment.
Show the network without turning the page into a directory, and host two contact modes: Roundtable and consultant meetings later, without complicating the page.
Day 1: Airbnb ESLint + a11y, Prettier, Husky. April 2025 V1 as separate pages.
November 2025: snap-scroll one-pager rewrite. Each section is a module (ui/, hooks/, utils/). Business logic extracted and architecture documented.
Trade-off: meeting booking is a functional prototype (calendar, slots, consultant, confirmation) without persisted reservations, shown as Coming Soon.

context.title: Product context
paragraphs: Audiences: entrepreneurs and partners joining or requesting the network; people discovering the holding.
Eight sections: Hero, About, Philosophy, Learn, Earn, Return, Network, Contact. Contact tabs: Roundtable form and Book a Meeting (weekdays, 15-min slots).
Out of v1: real booking, member area, blog, back office.

architecture.title: Architecture
paragraphs: Front: Next.js 15 + React 19. Root layout carries SEO and language/menu/network/animation providers. Page assembles eight modules.
Data: no backend. FR/EN via nested-key t(); members in a typed file; locale stored in the browser.
Calendar isolated in hooks/utils: weekdays, four slots 12:00–12:45. Confirmation injected as a parameter (toast today, API tomorrow). Web3Forms + toast. Hosted on Vercel.
bullets: 8 sections + header, mobile menu, network panel, calendar modal, footer
Generated OG image, JSON-LD, sitemap, robots

decisions.title: Key decisions
paragraphs: Hydration bug, step by step. Server does not know the browser locale. First version read preference immediately → FR HTML vs EN client flash. Fix (23/11): start FR on both sides, apply preference after mount. Side effect: language change restarted the Hero; decoupled on 01/12.
GSAP in gsap.context(), torn down on unmount so ScrollTriggers do not animate dead nodes.
Snap scroll + panel: save and restore read position on close. Unified navigation accounts for header height.
bullets: Dependency inversion: calendar confirmation as a parameter

execution.title: Delivery and next steps
paragraphs: 03-09/04/2025: multi-page V1. 23/11: one-page rewrite, snap scroll, hydration, client README. 01-02/12: hero, header, network, menu, logic extraction. 07/12: CVE. 29-30/01/2026: Book a call, ESLint 9, React 19. 01-06/02: About, SEO, Web3Forms, prod.
Numbers: 71 commits on 12 active days, 2 major PRs, 8 sections, 2 languages, 6 animation modules.

Honesty: architecture and UX before tests. No automated tests or CI yet (lint + Husky). Browser-side locale means Google mostly indexes FR. Next: real booking, Vitest for calendar/form, /fr /en routes, real member photos.
